title: Renewed Quantity and the Member's Home Delivery Refill Cycle
content:
The quantity a member-filed renewal of a quantity limit authorization asks for under the Utilization Management Program follows the refill cycle the member is on at the Home Delivery Pharmacy (Northbridge Rx Home Delivery). Here "the approved quantity" is the quantity per rolling 30 days approved on the authorization being renewed.

**Rule.**

1. A member **enrolled in automatic home delivery refills** whose **newest home delivery prescription for the drug is written for more than a 34-day supply** has the approved quantity multiplied by that prescription's days supply and divided by its days supply less the home delivery program's automatic refill lead days.
2. A member **not enrolled in automatic refills** who had **at least 3 home delivery shipments of the drug in the last six months** has the approved quantity divided by the home delivery program's refill eligibility fraction.
3. **Every other member** has the approved quantity as it stands.

The newest prescription is the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy prescription for the drug with the latest written date. The shipments are shipped Home Delivery Pharmacy orders of the drug; the six months end on the filing date, an order counting when dated after the same day of the month six months before the filing date. The enrollment, lead days and eligibility fraction are those of the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy account and program.

## Condition table

| Automatic refills | Newest home delivery prescription | Shipments in six months | Renewed quantity |
|---|---|---|---|
| Enrolled | more than 34 days supply | any | approved quantity times days supply, divided by days supply less lead days |
| Enrolled | 34 days or fewer, or none on file | any | approved quantity as it stands |
| Not enrolled | any | 3 or more | approved quantity divided by the eligibility fraction |
| Not enrolled | any | 0 to 2 | approved quantity as it stands |

## Illustration (hypothetical program figures: lead days 10, eligibility fraction 0.75; approved quantity 12)

- Enrolled, prescription for a 90-day supply: 12 multiplied by 90, divided by 80, gives 13.5.
- Not enrolled, 3 shipments in six months: 12 divided by 0.75 gives 16.
- Not enrolled, 1 shipment: 12.
